title: features/<feature>/versions.json
description: The version family for a feature prototyped in versions, and the change ledger for each version. Read by designmd/versions.js (the Versions + Changes plugins) and by anyone — person or agent — implementing the feature. See DESIGN.md §10.

family.description: Human name for the whole family, shown in the dock title bar.

folder.description: Folder name next to versions.json, e.g. v3-breadcrumb or v3.1-breadcrumb. Also the version's identity everywhere else.

note.description: One line on what this version is.

basedOn.description: The folder this version was branched from, or null for the first. A version that a later version is basedOn, and that never shipped, is superseded — the UI derives that, there is no stage for it.

kind.description: concept = a different idea, explored on purpose (v4). revision = the same idea changed after it locked (v3.1). Revisions nest under their concept in the version list.

stage.description: draft = yours, nobody has seen it; a change costs nothing. review = feedback open, nobody building; edit in place and add a ledger line. locked = someone is building against it; ANY change becomes a new version. shipped = built, now the as-built reference.

lockedAt.description: The day this version locked — i.e. the day its Jira ticket was picked up, not the day it was written. Required once stage is locked or shipped; compared against the Figma page's modified time to detect drift.

figma.description: The Figma page holding this version's happy paths, built AT lock. Absent before then — there is no Figma page for a draft.

page.description: Page name, matching the folder, e.g. "v3 · Breadcrumb + People".

nodeId.description: Page or frame node id, colon form, e.g. 38847:2305.

jira.description: Where this version is being built.

issue.description: The sub-task carrying this version's change list, e.g. OPS-141.

changes.description: What is new, moved, changed or removed in this version compared with basedOn. Each entry's id is stamped on the markup as data-change-id, written on the Figma page, and listed in the Jira sub-task — unmatched on any side means drift.

id.description: Stable id, <folder version>-<n>, e.g. v3-07 or v3.1-01.

summary.description: What changed, in a few words. Matches data-change-note on the marked element.

why.description: The reason, in one line. This is the part a ticket cannot reconstruct.

source.description: Where the change came from: prd, review, slack:<YYYY-MM-DD>, jira:<KEY>, or a person's name.

figmaNode.description: Node id of the affected frame or element, colon form.

status.description: pending = recorded, not scheduled. accepted = the person building it took it into the current ticket. deferred = it waits for a later version. built = it is in the code.

amendment.description: True only for a change that landed in place on a LOCKED version because the person building it accepted it first. Requires acknowledgedBy.

acknowledgedBy.description: Who accepted the amendment, and when.
